text: Easily breakable. All of the tips have broken off all of the nut pics already. The The actual nutcracker is still in one piece but I haven't used it nearly as much. The metal feels really cheap and like it's flaking. I do not recommend.

product_metadata.title: Nantucket Seafood Shell Cracker and Picks Set, , 5-Piece, 1 EA
features: PERFECT SEAFOOD TOOL SET The Nantucket Seafood Nutcracker and Pick Set includes one nutcracker and four picks. The set works great for cracking the shells of your favorite seafood like crab and lobster.
DURABLE CONSTRUCTION The seafood utensils are made of sturdy, durable zinc alloy. Tough enough to get inside and remove meat from crab legs, lobster tails, oysters, and a variety of nuts.

TEXTURED HANDLES One of the unique features of our seafood tool set is that each piece has textured handles for grip when hands are greasy from butter. The nutcracker also features a spring-loaded hinge for easy use.
PERFECT FOR CRACKING YOUR FAVORITE NUT The nutcracker in the set also works great to crack your favorite nut like chestnuts and walnuts.
CARE AND MEASUREMENTS Hand wash only with a soft sponge, soap and hot water. Not dishwasher safe. Dry immediately. Measures Cracker: 1. 5 x 5 inches, Picks: 0. 25 x 4. 5 inches.
